Sanders Calls Trump ‘Extraordinarily Dangerous’
On Saturday, in a post on
X
, Sanders accused Trump of disregarding the Constitution and the rule of law, describing him as a "corrupt narcissist" and a "pathological liar."
Sharing a clip of his remarks, Sanders called the upcoming midterms "the most important midterm election in the modern history of this country."
"Donald Trump is an extraordinarily dangerous president," Sanders said, accusing the president of running an "extremely corrupt administration."
He also criticized Trump’s economic policies, arguing that they favor wealthy Americans while placing a growing burden on working families.

"His policies are benefiting the oligarchs, and are causing severe pain for working families," Sanders said, pointing to "tax breaks for millionaires" and an estimated 15 million people losing health care coverage.
Sanders Urges Voters To Hold Trump Accountable
The Vermont senator also criticized congressional Republicans for failing to challenge the president.
"We cannot continue to have a president with a rubber-stamp House and Senate who bow down and do whatever he wants," Sanders said.
"We’ve got to hold Donald Trump accountable. That’s what this election is about," he added.
Sanders urged Americans to vote on Tuesday and encourage their friends and family members to participate, concluding, "Let’s win this election."
